entries.title: Divine Insight
entries.body:
# Divine Insight

## Overview
You offer a prayer to your patron, opening your mind to receive a fragment of their divine perception. For a short time, your senses become aligned with the ideals and domains of the deity you serve, granting insight that no mortal could achieve through their own understanding.

The form this insight takes is unique to every patron. A god of knowledge may reveal forgotten truths, a deity of life may perceive sickness and vitality, while a patron of death may sense lingering souls. Patrons of war, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own unique perspective upon the world.

Divine Insight does not reveal all things. Instead, it grants only the knowledge your patron chooses to share, allowing faithful servants to better carry out their divine purpose.

## Rank 1
### Description

You offer a prayer to your patron, opening your mind to receive a fragment of their divine perception. For a short time, your senses become aligned with the ideals and domains of the deity you serve, granting insight that no mortal could achieve through their own understanding.

The form this insight takes is unique to every patron. A god of knowledge may reveal forgotten truths, a deity of life may perceive sickness and vitality, while a patron of death may sense lingering souls. Patrons of war, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own unique perspective upon the world.

Divine Insight does not reveal all things. Instead, it grants only the knowledge your patron chooses to share, allowing faithful servants to better carry out their divine purpose.

### Effects

- Divine Insight is an **Active Talent**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight lasts **10 minutes**.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that the gods perceive the world through lenses beyond mortal comprehension. While no Cleric can truly share a deity's limitless awareness, those who have earned their patron's trust may briefly glimpse creation through divine eyes.

These sacred moments have guided pilgrims to forgotten shrines, revealed hidden dangers before catastrophe struck and uncovered truths that would otherwise have remained lost to history. Such revelations are never random; they are gifts bestowed with purpose, reminding every Cleric that true wisdom comes not from seeing everything, but from seeing what their patron wishes them to see.

> *"The gods reveal only what is needed, never what is desired."*

> — High Oracle Seraphine, Keeper of the Celestial Archives

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection with your patron has deepened, allowing you to receive clearer and more sustained moments of divine revelation. Through focused prayer and unwavering faith, you open your mind to a greater fragment of your patron's awareness, granting insight beyond mortal understanding.

No two patrons reveal the world in the same way. A deity of knowledge may uncover hidden truths and forgotten lore, while a patron of war may reveal tactical opportunities upon the battlefield. Gods of life, death, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own sacred perspective, ensuring that every Cleric experiences Divine Insight according to the ideals of the deity they serve.

As your faith grows, your patron entrusts you with increasingly profound guidance. These revelations are never without purpose, providing only the knowledge necessary to fulfil your patron's divine will rather than satisfying idle curiosity.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **75 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **15 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Among experienced Clerics, Divine Insight is regarded as one of the patron's greatest gifts. It is said that those who seek wisdom with a humble heart are occasionally granted fleeting glimpses of truths that lie beyond the understanding of ordinary mortals. These moments often alter the course of quests, uncover ancient secrets or reveal dangers before they come to pass.

Senior members of the faith teach that Divine Insight should never be used for personal gain. Every revelation carries purpose, and those who abuse their patron's trust soon find that the gods have little reason to continue sharing their wisdom. The wisest Clerics therefore approach every invocation with reverence, accepting that the greatest answers are those freely given, not demanded.

> *"Wisdom is not measured by what you discover, but by what you do with the truths entrusted to you."*
>
> — **Archsage Valerius, Keeper of the Divine Archives**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering faith allows your patron to share an even greater portion of their divine perception. Upon invoking Divine Insight, your awareness briefly transcends mortal limitations, revealing the world through the unique wisdom of the deity you serve. Every vision, sensation and revelation is shaped by your patron's divine purpose, granting guidance that no amount of study or experience could ever provide.

Each patron grants their insight differently. A deity of justice may reveal deception and hidden guilt, while a god of nature may expose disturbances within the natural world. Patrons of knowledge, war, life, death and countless other divine domains each provide their own perspective, ensuring that Divine Insight remains as unique as the deity from whom it originates.

As your bond continues to deepen, your patron entrusts you with increasingly meaningful revelations. These visions are never random; they are granted to guide your actions, strengthen your faith and aid you in fulfilling the divine purpose entrusted to you.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **90 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **20 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Throughout history, the Third Divine Insight has marked the point where a Cleric is recognised as a trusted vessel of their patron's wisdom. Many temples entrust these faithful servants with sacred relics, dangerous expeditions and matters of spiritual importance, knowing that their patron's guidance will illuminate paths hidden from ordinary eyes.

Ancient records tell of Clerics who uncovered forgotten kingdoms, exposed hidden corruption within powerful empires and discovered relics thought lost for millennia through moments of Divine Insight. Yet every account carries the same lesson: the revelation itself was never the reward. Rather, it was the responsibility that followed. Those granted divine knowledge are expected to act upon it with humility, wisdom and unwavering devotion to their patron's will.

> *"To receive divine insight is to accept the responsibility of acting upon divine truth."*
>
> — **High Hierophant Caelus, Keeper of the Eternal Scriptures**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with profound moments of divine revelation, allowing your mind to perceive the world through an even greater measure of their wisdom. When you invoke Divine Insight, your senses transcend ordinary mortal perception, revealing truths that align with your patron's divine domain and sacred purpose.

No two revelations are ever the same. A patron of life may perceive the health and vitality of every living creature, while a deity of war may reveal the flow of battle before a single blow is struck. Gods of knowledge, death, justice, nature and countless other domains each offer their own unique understanding of the world. Every vision is purposeful, revealing only that which serves your patron's will.

By this stage, your patron's guidance has become an invaluable companion. Whether exploring forgotten ruins, confronting powerful foes or seeking answers hidden by mortal limitations, Divine Insight grants clarity where uncertainty once prevailed.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **105 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **25 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Within the grand cathedrals of Asteria, only the most trusted Clerics are believed capable of receiving revelations of this magnitude. Such individuals are often called upon to investigate sacred mysteries, resolve disputes between temples and confront threats that ordinary wisdom cannot overcome. Their patron's guidance has become so refined that even the smallest vision may alter the course of history.

Ancient chronicles tell of High Clerics who uncovered hidden sanctuaries, exposed ancient betrayals and prevented devastating catastrophes after receiving moments of Divine Insight. These stories are not remembered because the visions were extraordinary, but because the faithful possessed the wisdom and courage to act upon them. Every revelation is a sacred responsibility, entrusted only to those who have demonstrated unwavering devotion.

> *"The patron does not reveal the future—they reveal the path that must be walked."*
>
> — **Grand Oracle Lysandra, Keeper of the Celestial Archives**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached such extraordinary heights that your patron entrusts you with the fullest expression of their divine perception. When you invoke Divine Insight, your mind becomes a vessel through which your deity briefly observes the mortal world, granting you profound understanding according to their divine domain and sacred purpose.

The revelations bestowed upon you are unique to your patron alone. A deity of knowledge may unveil secrets lost to history, while a patron of justice may expose deception hidden beneath the truth. Gods of war may reveal the flow of conflict, patrons of life may perceive the balance of every living soul, and deities of death may witness the unseen passage between life and the beyond. Every patron grants a perspective that no mortal could ever achieve alone.

Although this gift is immense, your patron reveals only what serves their greater purpose. Divine Insight is not omniscience—it is the privilege of seeing exactly what your patron believes you must know. Those who master this talent become trusted instruments of divine wisdom, carrying their patron's guidance into every corner of Asteria.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **120 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **30 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Insight**.

### Lore

Only the greatest High Clerics are ever said to attain the Fifth Divine Insight. Throughout history, these faithful servants have stood beside kings, guided heroes and uncovered truths that reshaped entire civilizations. Their wisdom was never born from superior intellect alone, but from the humility to seek guidance from the deity they served and the courage to follow wherever that guidance led.

The sacred texts teach that the highest form of Divine Insight is not the ability to see everything, but the wisdom to recognise what truly matters. Every revelation carries responsibility, every vision demands action and every truth revealed must be used in faithful service rather than personal ambition. Those who earn this blessing become living witnesses to their patron's will, forever remembered as beacons of wisdom within their faith.

> *"The greatest revelation is not to know all things, but to understand the one truth your patron asks you to carry into the world."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Divine Inspiration

## Overview
You call upon your patron to bestow a fragment of their divine will upon a creature within range. This blessing is not universal, but a direct expression of the deity you serve. Every patron grants inspiration differently, reflecting their ideals, domains and sacred purpose.

Whether offering hope, courage, wisdom, judgement or countless other divine gifts, Divine Inspiration allows your patron's influence to reach beyond yourself and touch another. The exact nature of this blessing is defined by your Patron page, ensuring every Cleric's Divine Inspiration remains unique to the deity they follow.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful expressions of their divine inspiration, allowing this sacred gift to grow alongside your journey.

## Rank 1
### Description

You call upon your patron to bestow a fragment of their divine will upon a creature within range. This blessing is not universal, but a direct expression of the deity you serve. Every patron grants inspiration differently, reflecting their ideals, domains and sacred purpose.

Whether offering hope, courage, wisdom, judgement or countless other divine gifts, Divine Inspiration allows your patron's influence to reach beyond yourself and touch another. The exact nature of this blessing is defined by your Patron page, ensuring every Cleric's Divine Inspiration remains unique to the deity they follow.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful expressions of their divine inspiration, allowing this sacred gift to grow alongside your journey.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration is a **Cantrip**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting this ability refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The scriptures tell that the gods rarely speak directly to mortals. Instead, they entrust fragments of their wisdom, conviction and purpose to those who faithfully carry out their will. Through Divine Inspiration, a Cleric becomes the vessel through which that sacred influence reaches the world, allowing others to briefly experience the guiding hand of the divine.

> *"The faithful do not create inspiration—they carry it from the heavens."*
>
> — *The Book of Divine Accord*

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's voice grows clearer as your faith deepens, allowing you to bestow a greater measure of their divine influence upon another. What was once a fleeting blessing now lingers with increased strength, giving your patron's will more time to shape the actions of the creature you inspire.

Every patron grants Divine Inspiration according to their own divine nature. Some kindle unwavering courage before battle, others grant profound wisdom, restore hope, instil righteous conviction or pronounce sacred judgement. No two patrons inspire in the same way, for every blessing is a reflection of the deity who grants it.

As your connection to your patron strengthens, so too does your ability to act as their chosen vessel. Those touched by your Divine Inspiration become living examples of your patron's influence, carrying a fragment of their divine purpose wherever they go until the blessing fades.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **20 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **4 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Among experienced Clerics, Divine Inspiration is regarded as one of the purest expressions of a patron's favour. Rather than performing miracles directly, the deity works through those they have chosen, allowing fragments of their will to guide faithful servants and worthy souls alike.

Many legends tell of ordinary people accomplishing extraordinary deeds after receiving a Cleric's blessing. Whether standing against overwhelming darkness, uncovering forgotten truths or showing unexpected compassion, these moments are remembered not as acts of chance, but as quiet reminders that the gods continue to shape the world through those devoted to their service.

> *"The greatest blessings are not always the loudest. Often, they are the quiet voice that gives a soul the strength to take one more step."*
>
> — **High Priest Althoran, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your bond with your patron has grown into a powerful conduit for divine influence. Through a simple prayer or sacred invocation, you may call forth a greater measure of your patron's inspiration, allowing their will to shape the destiny of another creature. The blessing has become more enduring, carrying the authority and purpose of the deity who bestowed it.

Every patron inspires in a different way. A deity of war may awaken indomitable resolve, while a patron of knowledge may illuminate the mind with unparalleled clarity. Gods of life, death, nature, justice and countless other divine domains each grant their own unique expression of Divine Inspiration, ensuring that no two Clerics wield the same blessing.

Those touched by your Divine Inspiration often find themselves accomplishing feats they once believed impossible. Whether through courage, wisdom, resilience or another sacred gift, they become temporary vessels for your patron's influence, carrying a fragment of divine purpose into the challenges that lie ahead.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **25 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **5 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Within the oldest temples of Asteria, Divine Inspiration is described as the sacred language through which the gods encourage their faithful without ever speaking a single word. Rather than commanding their followers directly, the patrons entrust fragments of their divine purpose to devoted Clerics, who in turn pass those blessings to others.

Those who receive such inspiration rarely describe it as overwhelming power. Instead, they speak of perfect certainty—a moment where fear fades, doubt disappears and every action feels guided by something far greater than themselves. These experiences often become lifelong memories, strengthening not only the recipient's resolve but also their faith in the patron whose grace reached them through the Cleric.

> *"The gods need not raise their voices. A single moment of true inspiration can change the course of a lifetime."*
>
> — **Saint Elyndor, Herald of the Divine Path**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's favour flows through you with remarkable clarity, allowing you to bestow a profound expression of their divine will upon another creature. The inspiration you invoke is no longer a fleeting blessing but a powerful manifestation of the sacred bond between deity and disciple. Those touched by your patron's grace become living reflections of the ideals your faith represents.

No two patrons inspire in the same manner. A deity of justice may embolden unwavering conviction, while a god of nature may awaken harmony with the world around them. Patrons of war, knowledge, life, death and countless other divine domains each grant unique blessings that shape the actions and destiny of those they touch.

As your connection with your patron continues to deepen, your Divine Inspiration becomes one of the clearest demonstrations of their presence within the mortal realm. Those who receive your blessing often speak of renewed purpose, unwavering certainty and a sense that a higher power walks beside them, guiding every step they take.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **30 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **6 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The Fourth Inspiration is regarded by many temples as a sacred milestone, reserved for Clerics whose devotion has remained unwavering through countless trials. By this stage, the patron's influence has become so refined that their blessing is recognised as more than divine magic—it is a direct expression of their will entrusted to mortal hands.

Throughout history, kings, generals and humble pilgrims alike have sought the blessing of such Clerics before undertaking journeys that would shape the fate of nations. Though each patron grants different gifts, every Divine Inspiration carries the same truth: the gods continue to guide the world through those who faithfully answer their call.

To receive such a blessing is considered a privilege. To bestow it is considered one of the greatest responsibilities a Cleric can bear.

> *"The greatest honour a servant can receive is to carry the will of their patron into the hearts of another."*
>
> — **Grand Hierophant Seraphiel, Voice of the Sacred Assembly**

## Rank 5
### Description

You have mastered the sacred art of Divine Inspiration, becoming one of the few mortals capable of serving as a flawless conduit for your patron's will. With a single invocation, you may call forth the greatest expression of your deity's inspiration, allowing their divine influence to rest upon another creature with unmatched strength and clarity.

The form this inspiration takes is determined entirely by your patron. Some grant unwavering courage in the face of impossible odds, others bestow profound wisdom, righteous judgement, serene compassion or fearsome conviction. Every patron's inspiration is unique, reflecting the ideals and purpose of the deity from whom it originates. No two Clerics share the same blessing unless they serve the same divine power.

Those who receive your Divine Inspiration often describe the experience as standing beside their patron themselves. Doubt fades, purpose becomes absolute and every action feels guided by a higher calling. Though the blessing eventually passes, its effects are often remembered for a lifetime, inspiring unwavering faith in those fortunate enough to receive it.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **35 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **8 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Inspiration**.

### Lore

Among the greatest legends of Asteria are tales of High Clerics whose words alone rekindled hope in broken armies, calmed kingdoms on the brink of collapse or inspired ordinary people to perform extraordinary acts of courage. While many believed these deeds were miracles, the faithful understood they were the highest expression of Divine Inspiration—a patron working through their chosen servant.

To master this blessing is to accept that you are not the source of divine power, but its vessel. Every prayer spoken, every blessing bestowed and every soul inspired serves as a reminder that the gods continue to shape the world through those who dedicate their lives to faithful service.

The greatest Clerics do not seek glory for themselves. They simply ensure that, wherever they travel, their patron's wisdom, purpose and inspiration continue to guide those who need it most.

> *"The greatest gift a god can grant is not power, but the ability to awaken greatness within another."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Divine Restoration

## Overview
You call upon your patron to restore a creature touched by divine purpose. Unlike ordinary restorative magic, Divine Restoration does not possess a universal effect. Instead, your patron grants the form of restoration most closely aligned with their divine domain and sacred ideals.

A patron of life may mend wounds and cure afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore clarity to a troubled mind. Gods of war may renew a warrior's endurance, patrons of nature may restore harmony to body and spirit, and deities of death may grant peaceful release from lingering curses or unnatural suffering. Every act of restoration is unique, reflecting the will of the patron who answers your prayer.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful forms of Divine Restoration, allowing your blessings to better fulfil their divine purpose.

## Rank 1
### Description

You call upon your patron to restore a creature touched by divine purpose. Unlike ordinary restorative magic, Divine Restoration does not possess a universal effect. Instead, your patron grants the form of restoration most closely aligned with their divine domain and sacred ideals.

A patron of life may mend wounds and cure afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore clarity to a troubled mind. Gods of war may renew a warrior's endurance, patrons of nature may restore harmony to body and spirit, and deities of death may grant peaceful release from lingering curses or unnatural suffering. Every act of restoration is unique, reflecting the will of the patron who answers your prayer.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful forms of Divine Restoration, allowing your blessings to better fulfil their divine purpose.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration is an **Active Talent**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that true restoration is more than repairing wounds—it is returning something to the state intended by the divine. Whether restoring flesh, spirit, resolve or balance, each patron heals according to their own sacred purpose.

The oldest scriptures tell of Clerics whose prayers restored far more than broken bodies. They rekindled hope within the hopeless, renewed courage in the defeated and brought harmony where corruption had taken root. Such miracles remind the faithful that restoration is not measured by what is repaired, but by what is made whole once again.

> *"The gods restore not what we desire, but what they deem worthy of renewal."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron entrusts you with a greater expression of their restorative power, allowing you to call upon blessings that reach beyond the limitations of mortal magic. As your devotion deepens, your prayers carry greater weight, enabling your patron to restore those in need according to their divine purpose.

The nature of this restoration remains unique to every deity. A patron of life may heal deeper wounds and purge greater afflictions, while a god of knowledge may restore forgotten memories or mental clarity. Patrons of war may renew a warrior's resolve, deities of nature may restore balance to corrupted lands or creatures, and gods of death may free souls from unnatural torment. Each act of restoration reflects the values of the patron who grants it rather than following a universal definition of healing.

By invoking Divine Restoration, you become a conduit through which your patron renews what they believe should be made whole. Every blessing serves a purpose beyond simple recovery, reinforcing the ideals and responsibilities of the faith you represent.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **65 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

The faithful teach that restoration is not measured by how much power is wielded, but by the wisdom behind its use. Every patron restores the world according to their own vision of balance, and every blessing is granted with deliberate purpose. Experienced Clerics learn that the greatest miracles often repair far more than flesh, mending broken spirits, shattered convictions or bonds thought forever lost.

Those who reach this stage of Divine Restoration are often entrusted with responsibilities beyond the battlefield. They become healers, judges, counsellors and guides, called upon whenever something precious has been damaged and only divine intervention can begin the process of making it whole once more.

> *"A miracle is not the act of restoring what was lost, but knowing what must be restored first."*
>
> — **High Priest Alaric, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has strengthened the sacred bond between yourself and your patron, allowing their restorative power to flow through you with far greater purpose. When you invoke Divine Restoration, you do not simply mend or recover—you become the instrument through which your deity restores what they believe should be made whole.

The form this restoration takes is entirely determined by your patron. A deity of life may mend grievous wounds or purge debilitating afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore forgotten memories or sharpen a clouded mind. Gods of war may rekindle a warrior's spirit, patrons of nature may restore harmony to corrupted life, and deities of death may ease unnatural suffering or return balance where death itself has been denied. Every miracle reflects the ideals of the divine being who grants it.

By this stage, your patron entrusts you with increasingly significant acts of restoration. These blessings often change the course of battles, save lives or restore that which seemed beyond recovery, demonstrating that true divine restoration extends far beyond physical healing.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **80 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Throughout Asteria's history, the Third Divine Restoration has marked the point where a Cleric becomes recognised as a true vessel of their patron's mercy and purpose. Their prayers are sought not merely because they possess great power, but because their patron has deemed them worthy of carrying miracles that few others can invoke.

Ancient accounts tell of devoted Clerics restoring hope to kingdoms consumed by despair, freeing souls from ancient curses and renewing sacred places that had fallen into ruin. Though the miracles themselves varied according to the patron, they all shared one truth: restoration is never granted without purpose. Every blessing carries the will of the deity who bestowed it, reminding both Cleric and recipient that divine power exists to uphold the balance their patron seeks within the world.

> *"Only when you understand what has truly been lost can you appreciate the miracle of its restoration."*
>
> — **Saint Aurelian, Keeper of the Sacred Light**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a profound expression of their restorative power, allowing your prayers to become vessels for miracles few mortals will ever witness. When you invoke Divine Restoration, you call not upon generic divine magic, but upon the unique will of your patron, who chooses what should be restored according to their sacred purpose.

Every deity defines restoration differently. A patron of life may mend devastating injuries or cleanse powerful afflictions, while a god of knowledge may restore forgotten truths and shattered minds. Patrons of war may reignite the spirit of a weary champion, deities of nature may return balance to corrupted creatures and lands, and gods of death may release souls bound by unnatural forces. Each blessing reflects the values and philosophy of the deity who grants it.

As your faith continues to mature, your patron's miracles become increasingly influential. Whether restoring a single life, renewing a sacred place or reversing the effects of powerful supernatural forces, Divine Restoration stands as a testament to the enduring bond between patron and Cleric.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **95 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Clerics capable of invoking the Fourth Divine Restoration are regarded as living conduits of their patron's mercy and purpose. Their presence is sought during times of great hardship, when ordinary magic has failed and only the direct blessing of a deity can restore what has been lost. Many become guardians of holy sites, advisors to rulers or leaders of sacred pilgrimages, trusted to wield miracles with wisdom and restraint.

The greatest temples teach that true restoration is never about returning the world to what it once was. Instead, it is about guiding it back toward the balance envisioned by the gods. Every miracle granted through Divine Restoration serves this higher purpose, reminding both the Cleric and those they aid that divine power exists not to defy fate, but to fulfil it.

> *"The patron restores not because the world is broken, but because they know what it was always meant to become."*
>
> — **Grand Hierophant Elyndor, Keeper of the Divine Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your patron has entrusted you with the highest expression of their restorative power, allowing you to invoke miracles that embody their divine purpose in its purest form. Through unwavering faith and absolute devotion, you become the chosen conduit through which your deity restores what they deem worthy, whether it be body, mind, spirit or another aspect of creation unique to their divine domain.

Every patron's Divine Restoration is unlike any other. A deity of life may perform miracles of extraordinary healing, while a patron of knowledge may restore memories thought forever lost. Gods of war may rekindle an indomitable fighting spirit, patrons of nature may return balance to lands scarred by corruption, and deities of death may release souls from unnatural imprisonment. Each miracle is a reflection of the patron's ideals, ensuring that no two Clerics restore the world in exactly the same way.

To master Divine Restoration is to accept that true restoration is never about reversing fate. Instead, it is about fulfilling the divine design envisioned by your patron, restoring what should endure while preserving the balance they seek to maintain throughout Asteria.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **110 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Restoration**.

### Lore

Only a handful of Clerics throughout history have been recognised as masters of Divine Restoration. Their names are remembered in every major faith, not because of the miracles they performed, but because of the wisdom with which they chose to perform them. Kings sought their counsel, entire nations prayed for their arrival, and even rival faiths respected the sacred authority they carried.

The oldest scriptures teach that the greatest miracle is not the restoration itself, but the judgement required to know when restoration should be granted. Those who wield the Fifth Divine Restoration understand that every blessing carries immense responsibility, for they act not according to personal desire, but as faithful servants carrying out the will of their patron.

To those who witness such miracles, one truth becomes unmistakably clear: the gods continue to shape the world, not through overwhelming displays of power, but through devoted souls willing to become instruments of their divine purpose.

> *"To restore another is to carry the will of the divine with humility, wisdom and unwavering faith."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Sacred Aegis
entries.body:
# Sacred Aegis

## Overview
You invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. While every Cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

The aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. Regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

As your faith deepens, your Sacred Aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

## Rank 1
### Description

You invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. While every Cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

The aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. Regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

As your faith deepens, your Sacred Aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis is a **Cantrip**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+2 AC** for the duration.
- Sacred Aegis lasts **3 rounds**.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis I** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Throughout Asteria, every faith tells stories of divine protection appearing when hope seemed lost. Some speak of radiant shields that turned aside deadly blows, while others describe ghostly guardians, living vines, celestial feathers or silent shadows that stood between the faithful and certain death. Though these manifestations differ, they all share a single truth—they are tangible signs that a patron has chosen to intervene.

Experienced Clerics understand that Sacred Aegis is more than a defensive blessing. It is a symbol of trust between deity and disciple, demonstrating that divine protection is not always about preventing harm, but ensuring the faithful endure long enough to fulfil the purpose laid before them.

> *"When faith becomes your shield, even the impossible may be endured."*
>
> — **Saint Valen, Guardian of the First Temple**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's divine protection grows stronger, allowing you to reinforce yourself or another creature with a more resilient Sacred Aegis. The blessing not only endures longer but offers greater protection against the dangers of battle, serving as a steadfast reminder that your patron watches over those who remain faithful.

Although every Cleric can invoke Sacred Aegis, no two manifestations are ever identical. The blessing takes the form most befitting your patron's divine nature, whether it appears as radiant light, celestial armour, sacred vines, spectral guardians or another divine manifestation. Regardless of its appearance, the aegis always provides a reliable shield that stands between the target and approaching danger.

As your connection with your patron deepens, they further empower your Sacred Aegis with blessings unique to their divine domain, allowing the protection to become more than a simple barrier against harm.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **25 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **4 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+3 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis II** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

As a Cleric's faith matures, so too does the strength of the divine protection entrusted to them. Veteran members of every faith are recognised not only by the miracles they perform, but by their ability to stand as guardians of others, placing themselves between danger and those under their patron's care.

Many ancient records tell of Sacred Aegis protecting champions during impossible battles, allowing them to survive blows that should have ended their lives. While historians often argue over the appearance of these blessings, every account agrees on one truth—the protection was never born from the Cleric's power alone, but from the unwavering faith that connected them to their patron.

> *"A shield forged by faith is strengthened by every trial it endures."*
>
> — **High Protector Aleron, Warden of the Sacred Bastion**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become a steadfast bastion through which your patron's protection flows with unwavering strength. When you invoke Sacred Aegis, divine power surrounds yourself or another creature, forming a resilient ward that shields them from danger while carrying the unmistakable mark of your patron's influence.

Although every Sacred Aegis provides the same fundamental protection, each patron leaves their own divine signature upon the blessing. Some manifest as radiant halos, others as spectral armour, shimmering runes, living branches, celestial wings or countless other sacred forms. Regardless of its appearance, the aegis stands as a visible declaration that the protected creature is under the watchful care of a higher power.

As your connection to your patron deepens, the divine blessing grows more formidable. The protection itself strengthens, while your patron weaves additional miracles into the aegis, allowing it to serve as both a shield against harm and a reflection of their divine domain.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **30 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **5 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+4 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis III** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The Third Sacred Aegis marks the point where a Cleric is recognised as a trusted protector within their faith. Veteran adventurers often seek such Clerics before embarking upon dangerous expeditions, knowing that their patron's blessing has turned aside countless fatal blows throughout history.

Ancient scriptures describe Sacred Aegis as more than a defensive miracle. It is a sacred promise between patron and disciple that the faithful will never stand alone while fulfilling their divine purpose. Though the form of the blessing differs from one deity to another, every manifestation carries the same enduring message—that courage is strongest when shielded by unwavering faith.

> *"The divine does not promise a life without hardship. It promises that the faithful shall never face it alone."*
>
> — **Archbishop Seraphis, Guardian of the Eternal Bastion**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's protection has become a formidable divine safeguard, allowing you to envelop yourself or another creature within an aegis capable of withstanding even the fiercest assaults. Through unwavering faith, you have become a trusted conduit for your patron's protective power, calling upon a blessing that few Clerics are capable of wielding.

Every Sacred Aegis shares the same sacred foundation, yet each patron leaves an unmistakable mark upon the blessing. To some it appears as radiant armour forged from holy light, while others witness celestial feathers, shimmering runes, spectral guardians, sacred vines or manifestations known only to followers of that deity. Though their appearances differ, each aegis serves the same purpose—to shield the faithful while reinforcing them with the unique blessings of their patron.

As your devotion continues to deepen, the protective barrier grows ever stronger, allowing your patron to weave increasingly powerful divine gifts into the blessing. Those protected by your Sacred Aegis often find themselves standing firm against overwhelming adversity, sustained by both the universal protection of the aegis and the additional favour granted by their patron.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **35 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **6 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+5 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis IV** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Among the great temples of Asteria, those capable of invoking the Fourth Sacred Aegis are often appointed as guardians of holy relics, protectors of sacred sites and defenders of those unable to defend themselves. Their patron's blessing has become so refined that even seasoned warriors feel a renewed sense of confidence beneath its protection.

Many ancient chronicles tell of battles where a single Cleric stood at the heart of a desperate defence, their Sacred Aegis preserving allies against impossible odds until victory could be won. Though each patron manifested their protection differently, every account reached the same conclusion: divine protection is not measured by the brilliance of the shield, but by the lives preserved beneath it.

> *"The strongest fortress is not built of stone, but of faith shared between the divine and the faithful."*
>
> — **Grand Protector Althorin, Warden of the Sacred Citadel**

## Rank 5
### Description

You have mastered the sacred art of divine protection, allowing your patron's aegis to reach its fullest expression. With a single invocation, you may surround yourself or another creature in an exceptionally powerful ward, shielding them from harm while carrying the unmistakable blessing of the deity you serve. Few Clerics ever attain this level of divine favour, and those who do are recognised as living guardians of their faith.

Every Sacred Aegis shares the same unbreakable foundation of divine protection, yet every patron shapes the blessing according to their own sacred nature. One deity may cloak their faithful in radiant light, another in celestial armour, living branches, spectral wings or ancient runic sigils. Though the appearance differs, the purpose remains constant—to preserve those chosen by the divine while empowering them with blessings unique to their patron.

At its highest rank, Sacred Aegis stands as both a shield and a symbol. It represents the unwavering covenant between patron and disciple, protecting those entrusted to your care while reminding all who witness it that true strength is found through faith, devotion and the enduring favour of the divine.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **40 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **8 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+6 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis V** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.
- You have mastered **Sacred Aegis**.

### Lore

Throughout the history of Asteria, only the greatest champions of the faith have wielded the Fifth Sacred Aegis. Their names are remembered not because they stood above others, but because they stood before them. They became the first line of defence against darkness, placing themselves between danger and those unable to protect themselves, trusting completely in the blessing granted by their patron.

The oldest scriptures teach that the greatest shield is not one that makes its bearer invincible, but one that allows others to endure long enough to fulfil their purpose. Every manifestation of Sacred Aegis reflects this truth. Whether protecting a lone traveller, an entire adventuring party or the defenders of a kingdom, the blessing exists to preserve hope when all other defences have failed.

Those who master Sacred Aegis become living symbols of their patron's protection. Wherever they walk, the faithful take comfort knowing that even amidst overwhelming darkness, the divine continues to stand beside those who refuse to yield.

> *"The measure of a guardian is not how many blows they withstand, but how many lives remain standing because they chose to protect them."*
>
> — **Saint Valen, First Shield of the Divine**

entries.title: Ritual Blessing
entries.body:
# Ritual Blessing

## Overview
Not all divine power is called upon in battle.

## Rank 1
### ✨ Description

Not all divine power is called upon in battle.

Some must be prepared… drawn slowly through prayer, symbol, and intent.

*Ritual Blessing* allows you to channel divine energy outside of combat, weaving temporary enchantments, protections, and minor blessings that prepare your allies for what lies ahead.

At Rank 1, your rituals are simple—but meaningful.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Apply a minor blessing to allies |
| Secondary Effect | Create a ritual space |
| Role | Pre-combat utility |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat use only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (5m radius)**

- Allies within the space may receive:
  - **1 Blessing effect**

---

#### 🌟 Minor Blessing (Choose 1)

Apply to all allies within the ritual:

---

##### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+5 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **10 minutes**

---

##### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+1 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

##### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+5% resistance to one damage type (chosen at cast)**
- Duration:
  - **10 minutes**

---

👉 Only **one blessing may be active at a time per target**

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge** during the ritual:

- Enhance the blessing:

- Effects:
  - **+50% duration**
  - OR
  - **Increase effect strength slightly (GM scaling)**

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Cannot be cast in combat  
- Effects **persist into combat**  

- Encourages:
  - Preparation  
  - Strategic planning  
  - Team coordination  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Target has an active blessing |
| Sacred Preparation | Buff applied before combat |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Single Blessing | Cannot stack multiple rituals |
| Modest Effects | Bonuses are intentionally small |
| Time Requirement | Requires setup time |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

If interrupted during casting:

- Ritual fails  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Ritual feels stronger (flavour) |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Ritual feels unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Add multiple blessing choices  
  - Allow stacking or layering  
  - Extend duration significantly  
  - Add combat-triggered effects  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances ritual strength  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained combat synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Supports repeated rituals  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports long rituals  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Core identity:
  - **Preparation & utility system**

- Gameplay role:
  - Pre-combat advantage  
  - Team support  
  - Strategic setup  

---

### 📖 Lore

There are powers that answer in an instant.

And there are powers that must be invited.

Through ritual, symbol, and quiet devotion, you create a space where the divine may linger—not as force, but as presence.

And those who stand within it…

Carry that presence with them.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“Power given in silence often lasts the longest.”*

## Rank 2
### ✨ Description

Your rituals deepen in structure and intent.

What was once a simple invocation now carries weight—your symbols are more precise, your focus more refined, and the divine presence you invite lingers longer.

At Rank 2, your blessings are no longer fleeting… they are **reliable preparation tools**.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Improved blessing strength |
| Secondary Effect | Increased duration |
| New Effect | Limited dual blessing option |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat use only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (5m radius)**

- Allies within the space may receive:
  - **1 Blessing effect**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Improved)

Choose **1 primary blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+8 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **15 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+2 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+8% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **15 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark (NEW — Limited Dual Blessing)

You may apply a **Secondary Mark**:

- Choose **a different blessing type**

- Effect:
  - Applies at **50% effectiveness**

👉 Example:
- Vitality (primary) + Focus (secondary)

---

#### ⚠️ Secondary Mark Rules

- Only **1 secondary blessing allowed**
- Cannot duplicate the same blessing type
- Secondary effect is always reduced

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge** during the ritual:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Blessing**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Blessing**
  - Increase primary blessing effectiveness slightly  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot be cast in combat  

- Effects:
  - Persist into combat  

- Now enables:
  - More flexible pre-combat preparation  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary blessing |
| Sacred Preparation | Pre-combat buff state |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Limited Layering | Only 1 secondary effect allowed |
| Reduced Power | Secondary effect is weaker |
| Time Requirement | Requires setup time |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

If interrupted:

- Ritual fails  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Ritual feels stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance results (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Secondary effects may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Allow stronger secondary effects  
  - Introduce persistent ritual zones  
  - Add combat-triggered bonuses  
  - Enable multi-ritual layering  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances blessing strength  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained combat synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Supports repeated rituals  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports longer rituals  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Evolves into:
  - **Flexible preparation system**

- Adds:
  - Choice  
  - Layering  
  - Strategic setup  

---

### 📖 Lore

The first rituals are simple.

But as your understanding deepens, you begin to weave intention into every motion—every mark, every word, every breath carrying purpose.

The divine does not simply answer you now…

It lingers where you invite it.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“One blessing prepares you…  
two may change what comes next.”*

## Rank 3
### ✨ Description

Your rituals no longer merely invoke power…

They express belief.

The divine presence you call upon now shapes itself according to your Path, changing not only the strength of your blessings—but their purpose.

At Rank 3, *Ritual Blessing* becomes a reflection of who you are as a Cleric.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Enhanced blessing strength |
| Secondary Effect | Secondary Mark retained |
| New Effect | Pathway modifies ritual behaviour |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (6m radius)**

- Allies within the space receive:
  - **1 Primary Blessing**
  - Optional **Secondary Mark**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Improved)

Choose **1 Primary Blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+10 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **20 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+2 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+10% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **20 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark

- Apply:
  - **1 additional blessing at 50% effectiveness**

---

### 🌌 Pathway Infusion (NEW)

---

#### 🟡 Path of Radiance — *Blessing of Renewal*

- Primary Blessing gains:
  - **+10% increased healing received (10 min)**

- Vitality:
  - Temp HP increases slightly  

👉 Focus: **Sustain & recovery**

---

#### 🔵 Path of Preservation — *Blessing of Safeguard*

- Allies gain:
  - **−2 damage taken (first hit in combat)**

- Resistance:
  - Slightly more effective  

👉 Focus: **Defense & survival**

---

#### 🟣 Path of Illumination — *Blessing of Insight*

- Allies gain:
  - **+1 to all skill checks for 10 minutes**

- Focus:
  - Slightly stronger  

👉 Focus: **Utility & control**

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge**:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Ritual**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Ritual**
  - Increase primary effect  

- **Path Amplification (NEW)**
  - Strengthens Pathway effect  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot be cast in combat  

- Effects:
  - Persist into combat  

- Now:
  - Provide stronger **pre-combat identity advantage**

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary effect |
| Path Infusion | Blessing modified by pathway |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Limited Layering | Only 1 secondary effect |
| Path Lock | Pathway is permanent |
| Modest Scaling | Effects remain controlled |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

- Ritual fails if interrupted  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Path effects feel stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Ritual stability reduced |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Add multi-ritual effects  
  - Create persistent ritual zones  
  - Introduce combat-triggered blessings  
  - Expand Pathway impact  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances rituals  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Enables repeated casting  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports ritual stability  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Evolves into:
  - **Identity-based preparation system**

- Adds:
  - Pathway expression  
  - Strategic pre-combat advantage  
  - Role differentiation  

---

### 📖 Lore

There was a time when your rituals called upon the divine.

Now…

They reveal it.

The symbols you draw, the words you speak, the space you create—they are no longer just tradition.

They are truth made visible.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“The ritual does not change…  
you do.”*

## Rank 4
### ✨ Description

Your rituals no longer fade when you leave them behind.

The divine presence you invoke now lingers—woven into your allies and the battlefield itself, waiting for the moment it is needed most.

At Rank 4, your blessings are no longer just preparation…

They are **promises waiting to be fulfilled**.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation / Triggered) |
| Core Effect | Enhanced blessings |
| Secondary Effect | Secondary Mark retained |
| New Effect | Delayed trigger blessing |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (6m radius)**

- Allies within the space receive:
  - **1 Primary Blessing**
  - Optional **Secondary Mark**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Improved)

Choose **1 Primary Blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+12 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **25 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+3 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+12% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **25 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark

- Apply:
  - **1 additional blessing at 50% effectiveness**

---

### ⚡ Delayed Blessing (NEW)

Each affected ally gains a **Stored Trigger Effect**:

---

#### 🎯 Trigger Condition (choose one at ritual)

- When HP drops below **50%**
- When taking a **heavy hit**
- When failing a saving throw  

---

#### 💫 Trigger Effect

- Upon trigger:
  - Gain:
    - **Minor healing (1d6 + Faith)**  
    - OR
    - **+2 to next roll**  
    - OR
    - **−2 damage taken (1 instance)**  

👉 Trigger:
- Activates **once per target**
- Consumes the stored blessing  

---

### 🌌 Pathway Infusion (Enhanced)

---

#### 🟡 Path of Radiance — *Lingering Renewal*

- Delayed Blessing:
  - Healing effect becomes:
    - **1d8 + Faith**

- Vitality:
  - Slightly increased  

---

#### 🔵 Path of Preservation — *Guarded Fate*

- Delayed Blessing:
  - Damage reduction increases:
    - **−3 (1 instance)**

- Resistance:
  - Slightly stronger  

---

#### 🟣 Path of Illumination — *Foreseen Response*

- Delayed Blessing:
  - Trigger may:
    - **Reroll failed saving throw instead**

- Focus:
  - Slightly stronger  

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge**:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Ritual**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Ritual**
  - Increase primary blessing  

- **Triggered Amplification**
  - Strengthens delayed effect  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot cast in combat  

- Effects:
  - Persist into combat  
  - Trigger during combat  

- Enables:
  - Pre-loaded defensive or utility responses  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary effect |
| Stored Blessing | Delayed trigger effect |
| Path Infusion | Pathway modifies effects |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Single Trigger | Each stored effect triggers once |
| Non-Combat Cast | Cannot refresh mid-fight |
| Controlled Power | Effects are intentionally moderate |
| Path Lock | Pathway is fixed |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

- Ritual fails if interrupted  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Triggers feel stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Trigger reliability may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Rank 5 may:
  - Allow multiple triggers  
  - Create persistent ritual zones  
  - Add powerful delayed effects  
  - Enable combat-linked ritual influence  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances triggers  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained healing synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Enables repeated rituals  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports stability  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Evolves into:
  - **Pre-loaded defensive / utility system**

- Adds:
  - Delayed impact  
  - Strategic foresight  
  - Pre-combat planning depth  

---

### 📖 Lore

A true ritual does not end when the words are spoken.

It waits.

It lingers.

It listens.

And when the moment comes…

It answers.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“The blessing was given long before it was needed.”*

## Rank 5
### ✨ Description

Your rituals no longer prepare for battle…

They define it.

The divine presence you call upon does not fade—it lingers, anchors, and shapes the flow of events long after the ritual is complete. What was once a blessing is now a **field of influence**, woven into those who carry it and the space they fight within.

At Rank 5, *Ritual Blessing* becomes a true expression of foresight—power placed where it will matter most.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation / Field Influence) |
| Core Effect | Enhanced blessings |
| Secondary Effect | Secondary Mark retained |
| New Effect | Ritual Field + Empowered Trigger |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (8m radius)**

- Allies within the space receive:
  - **1 Primary Blessing**
  - Optional **Secondary Mark**
  - **Stored Trigger Effect**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Final)

Choose **1 Primary Blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+15 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **30 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+3 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+15% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **30 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark

- Apply:
  - **1 additional blessing at 50% effectiveness**

---

### ⚡ Stored Blessing (Enhanced)

- Each ally gains:
  - **1 Trigger Effect**

---

#### 🎯 Trigger Options

- HP drops below **50%**
- Take a **heavy hit**
- Fail a saving throw  

---

#### 💫 Trigger Effects (Improved)

- Choose at ritual:

- **Healing**
  - **1d8 + Faith**

- **Protection**
  - **−3 damage (1 instance)**

- **Guidance**
  - **+2 to next roll OR reroll failed save**

👉 Each effect triggers:
- **Once per target**

---

### 🌌 Ritual Field (NEW — Signature Effect)

Once per ritual, you create a lingering **Ritual Field**:

---

#### 🌟 Field Effect (Choose 1)

---

##### 🟡 Field of Renewal
- Allies within **8m**:
  - Gain:
    - **+2 HP regeneration per round**
- Duration:
  - **3 rounds (combat)**

---

##### 🔵 Field of Safeguard
- Allies within **8m**:
  - Gain:
    - **−2 damage taken per hit**
- Duration:
  - **3 rounds**

---

##### 🟣 Field of Insight
- Allies within **8m**:
  - Gain:
    - **+1 to all rolls**
- Duration:
  - **2 rounds**

---

👉 Field activates:
- At start of combat  
**OR**
- When first ally triggers Stored Blessing  

---

### 🌌 Pathway Infusion (Final Form)

---

#### 🟡 Path of Radiance — *Sanctified Renewal*

- Field of Renewal:
  - Gains:
    - **+1 additional HP regen**

- Stored Healing:
  - Gains:
    - **+1d6 bonus healing**

---

#### 🔵 Path of Preservation — *Sanctified Bastion*

- Field of Safeguard:
  - Gains:
    - **−3 damage taken**

- Stored Protection:
  - Gains:
    - **−4 damage reduction**

---

#### 🟣 Path of Illumination — *Sanctified Insight*

- Field of Insight:
  - Gains:
    - **+2 to all rolls (instead of +1)**

- Stored Guidance:
  - Always:
    - **Grants reroll instead of +2**

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge**:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Ritual**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Blessing**
  - Increase primary blessing  

- **Field Amplification**
  - Increase Ritual Field effectiveness  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot cast in combat  

- Now:
  - Effects:
    - Trigger  
    - Persist  
    - Influence battlefield  

- Enables:
  - Pre-combat strategy  
  - Area control before engagement  
  - Layered support systems  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary effect |
| Stored Blessing | Delayed trigger effect |
| Ritual Field | Active area influence |
| Path Infusion | Effects shaped by pathway |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Cast | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Single Field | Only one field per ritual |
| Limited Duration | Field is short-lived |
| Controlled Power | Effects remain moderate |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

- Ritual fails if interrupted  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Field feels stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual |
| Corrupted Zones | Field may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (End of Tier 1)

- Evolves into:
  - Tier 2 → Persistent zones / area control  
  - Tier 3 → Consecrated ground systems  
  - Tier 4 → Divine territory / domain effects  

- Strong synergy with:
  - [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances field  
  - [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained aura synergy  
  - [[Mana Well]] → Enables repeated rituals  
  - [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports setup  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Final evolution of:
  - **Preparation → Layering → Identity → Trigger → Field Influence**

- Defines:
  - Cleric’s **pre-combat control identity**

---

### 📖 Lore

A ritual is not a moment.

It is a decision made before the outcome is known.

A space where the divine is invited not to act—but to remain.

And when the moment comes…

That presence answers.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“The battle was decided… long before it began.”*
